MangroVision

A real-time dashboard for MANGROVISION, an AI system that analyzes drone imagery of mangroves. It turns detections into live insights on species composition, tree health and canopy density, with interactive charts, a density heatmap and filters by date, location, species and health status, so conservation teams can quickly see where mangroves need attention.

Python CustomTkinter SQLite PyTorch Sentence-Transformers OpenCLIP OpenCV scikit-learn

Findora – Smart Lost and Found System

Findora is a lost-and-found desktop app for Himamaylan City, built with Python and SQLite. People report lost or found items with a description, photos and a location on a map, and the app uses AI to pair lost reports with found ones. Owners prove an item is theirs by passing an encrypted quiz, and suspicious claims are flagged for staff to review. Items are handed over at a desk using a PIN, and the app produces a PDF receipt. Each item keeps a full record from the first report until it's returned.

Komisyon Tracker

Commission tracker for freelancers and sales agents that calculates commissions, tracks partial payments and overdue balances, and forecasts income with goals and analytics.

BiblioTech Library System

BiblioTech is a library management system built with PHP and MySQL. It has a public catalog, a staff console and a member self-service portal. Staff can check books in and out with a barcode scanner, manage a holds queue, and handle fines, payments and printed receipts. The system also includes live analytics, reports with CSV export, role-based access, an audit log, and dark and light themes.
